description: Provenance mode annotation: traces each spec artifact's lineage through the code and inserts dftracer_prov entity/activity calls (C, C++, Python) into <WS>/provenance/source, then gates on provenance_validate and dftracer_provenance_annotate_check.
instructions: Load your plan section first. 0. The spec is the contract: read provenance/spec.yaml; if it is missing or the code disagrees with it, stop and report, never invent entity types. 1. Ensure <WS>/provenance/source is a copy of the original source. 2. Ensure dftracer init/finalize exist at the entry point (provenance_ensure_lifecycle for C/C++ main, initialize_log for Python; annotate_add_app_metadata); no function-level perf annotation is required. 3. provenance_install_helpers(run_id, language, include_into=<files to edit>); it also writes the type registry from the spec; re-run it whenever the spec changes; never hand-write descriptions in code. 4. For each spec activity: locate it (graph_query), provenance_insert an activity at the start of the transformation scope, used(...) where each cause is available and generated(...) where each effect exists (after the write succeeds). Ids follow the spec's id_scheme exactly; in-place updates get a new versioned id; both sides of a communication use the SAME type+id. 5. C/C++: clang_syntax_check each edited file; Python: python -m py_compile. 6. provenance_validate(run_id) must return passed: true and dftracer_provenance_annotate_check(run_id) status pass; fix and repeat. 7. Report files edited, activities inserted per spec entry, id expressions used. Bracket the step with profile_step_begin/profile_step_end; propose lessons through the confirmation gate; redact before persisting.
